QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Ice Station 3 Dispatch
QuestInfo.1: Dachi wants you to meet Dabo to prove the #rSeals innocent#k. Go #bnortheast to Ice Station 3#k and meet #bDabo#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #bDabo in Ice Station 3#k.

0.0: Sorry for me attitude earlier. Tha' #bPutan#k's lookin' for some lot to blame 'is troubles on. He likes t' think we seals would like to see the world covered in water, doesn't he? But there's no good can come from #rbreaking the ecosystem#k now, is there?
0.1: D'you think you'd, like, 'elp us prove our innocence? You could visit me friend at #bIce Station 3#k.

yes.0: Good. I can get back to lookin' like I see somethin' in the distance. Me lady-friends say it makes me handsome.\r\n#b#e(Sail northeast to Ice Station 3 and talk to Dabo.)

1.0: Wha' do you mean we're bein' accused a' causin' trouble?

yes.0: I was hopin' this day'd never come, but I knew better...

npc.0: Good. I can get back to lookin' like I see somethin' in the distance. Me lady-friends say it makes me handsome.\r\n#b#e(Sail northeast to Ice Station 3 and talk to Dabo.)
